#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> costs;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
            even++;
        } else {
            odd++;
        }
        if (even == odd) {
            costs.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int cost : costs) {
        if (cost <= B) {
            ans++;
            B -= cost;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << ans;
    cout.flush();
    return 0;
}
